title: ZZX-VSS
blurb: Verification Security System — Age-gated verification and credential vault for 18+ and 21+ adult content ecosystems. Uses secure facial imaging scans, photo ID capture, and facial-recognition matching to verify users while storing all documents in heavily encrypted form. User verification records can only be decrypted via per-user, court-authority key signing, providing a privacy-preserving, compliance-ready verification backbone for third-party platforms.
